name: moods
from: written as SVG rather than drawn
//: Eight faces, written as SVG and baked, in place of a set taken from an icon library. What made the difference is the brief rather than the drawing: a circle of ten, few features and big ones, nothing under two units, no enclosed shape under five, and eyes as dots or short strokes and never as small circles — a small circle at 24 dots is a blot. Then eyebrows on every one of them, which is where the expression actually lives: two thick strokes well clear of the eyes, angled, and the biggest features after the mouth.
//marks: No sad one. Eight marks that jump on the beat are a room enjoying itself, and a long face in the middle of the row is somebody who has had bad news.
//heights: Two dots of pen rather than three. These are written rather than traced, so nothing needs thickening, and at three the features inside the circle close up.
